details.test_11: Replay used pre-lock evaluation time; concurrent committed event appeared future relative to stale time. Fixture also used independent frozen clocks.
details.test_15: Clock rollback was rejected as EVENT_CLOCK_BINDING, not the expected explicit CLOCK_ROLLBACK diagnostic.
details.test_27: Concurrent-head fixture inherited the same stale/frozen time behavior and did not test one-winner CAS correctly.

resolution: Resample time and recheck identity/permission inside the acquired transaction. Use one synchronized fixture clock for concurrent operations; test one successful append and one stale-head rejection. Preserve all temporal gates.
